correctness.rationale: For any edge-general-position set with at least two selected edges, its minimal spanning subtree must select every pendant edge and no internal edge; conversely leaf edges of any subtree cannot place three selected edges on a path. Maximality is equivalent to the absence of an unused external edge at an internal hull vertex. The leaf-degree identity, exact two types of rooted continuation, and the one-edge correction derive both complete polynomials, the least maximal degree, extremal coefficients, and path-or-star characterization. The standalone checker independently tested every edge subset on all 18,247 labelled trees of orders three through seven and 450 additional seeded trees of orders eight through ten (18,697 instances; 556,214 feasible and 172,716 maximal edge sets). The unrestricted result rests on the proof, not the finite checks.

originality.rationale: The first 2021 paper determines only the maximum tree edge-general-position cardinality and contains a useful one-sided-edge lemma, not all maximal tree hulls or the lower number. The 2023 extremal paper gives maximum-cardinality bounds. The 2022 k-edge paper studies different maximum and covering problems. A published spider-tree census exactly covers the one-branch-vertex special case, acknowledged and excluded from novel coverage; its full RESULT text was examined and explicitly notes lack of extension to general trees. The present saturated-subtree characterization, all-tree maximal-set recursion and lower-number characterization are not implied by the special-case theorem, and were not located in searches of indexed literature or published-finding corpus. A prior tree-corona general-position result has a related leaf-subtree weighting but no statement on maximal edge subsets of the original tree. Priority remains provisional.
residual_risks: An unindexed exact all-tree statement, including under alternative terminology, cannot be excluded.
The higher-k 2022 paper was compared through its relevant available framework and summary, not every page.
A generic preexisting dynamic-programming machinery might permit a parallel derivation; priority has not been independently validated.

value.rationale: This is an unrestricted classification for all tree topologies, including arbitrary numbers of branching vertices. It gives the complete inclusion-maximal edge-set cardinality polynomial, a natural new lower/greedy invariant equal to the minimum nonleaf degree, a sharp path-or-star equicardinality criterion, and counts of extremal configurations, all computable by rooted polynomial-time recurrences. The critical saturated-hull condition is not a mere substitution into the known maximum-size formula or the previous spider theorem, and determines which otherwise valid edge sets are maximal. This is a motivated graph-distance obstruction enumeration, with concrete future utility for studying greedy outcomes and extremal edge-set distributions.
